card.name: Report words in warning statements
card.fires_on: Words that start a report of an adverse event in warnings, such as Case(s) before reports, reported after have been, and induced after drug. Also the word to in a year range.

modes.label: Case reports
modes.description: The word Case or Cases opening a sentence about reported adverse events.

modes.label: Drug-induced
modes.description: The word induced after drug in a leukopenia or neutropenia history.
modes.example: a history of drug<< induced>> leukopenia or neutropenia should

modes.label: Have been reported
modes.description: The word reported after have been in a boxed warning.
modes.example: exacerbations of hepatitis B have been<< reported>> in patients with HIV-1 and HB

card.writes: It pushes toward success words, which is a weak and unclear link to these warning phrases.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in warnings that introduce reports of side effects, like case reports or drug-induced.
